runtime_prompt_en:
Create a complex landscape editorial photograph inside an orbital observatory control room during a minor micrometeoroid alert. An original visibly adult astronomer with the reference portrait's visible facial structure, dark eyes with similar aperture and spacing, tapered lower-face shape, center-parted hairline, and long dark wavy hair adjusts a physical telescope control with clear hand-to-control contact. Frame the astronomer from the chest up at eye level on the left, with the face large, unobstructed, textured, and clearly lit for appearance-only comparison. On the right, a large nontext scientific observation display presents barred spiral morphology with arms attached to the bar ends: a sufficiently face-on barred spiral galaxy in false-color multiwavelength light. One luminous central bulge remains centered inside the galactic disk; an elongated stellar bar visibly crosses the central bulge; spiral arms begin near both ends of the central bar; the bulge bar and arms remain embedded in one coherent galactic disk. Use restrained cool instrument light plus a warm facial key, believable tactile controls, and alert-state reflections, with independent legibility of both the adult astronomer and the complete galaxy morphology.

Avoid: body distortion, distorted fingers, unrealistic hands, plastic-looking skin, low resolution, over-processed retouching, 3D render look, illustration look
